definitions.explanation: A group of people related by blood, marriage, or adoption living together.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}しました→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。

ご{家族|かぞく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Is your family well? Please give my regards to your father too.
examples.notes: ご⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ = your family (polite)

examples.english: On weekends, I look forward to cooking with my family and eating together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家族|かぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧{家族|かぞく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めています→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: He is a person who values his family and has decided not to work on Sundays but to spend them with his family.

notes:
{家族|かぞく} is the standard word for family—the group of people related by blood, marriage, or adoption.

REGISTER:
- {家族|かぞく}: my family (neutral)
- ご⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧: your/someone's family (polite)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {家族|かぞく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: My family has ~ people
- {家族|かぞく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: together with family
- {家族|かぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to value one's family
